# Vagdevi Food Products Private Limited

> Vagdevi Food Products Private Limited is a rice miller and exporter at Yadgarpally, Miryalaguda, in the Nalgonda district of Telangana, India. Paddy is bought directly from farmers in the surrounding mandals and dried, milled, graded, colour-sorted and packed on a single ISO 22000:2018 certified site. The company supplies bulk buyers, private-label brands and export customers, and sells under its own Surya and Dwaraka brands.

- Legal name: Vagdevi Food Products Private Limited (trading as Vagdevi Food Products / Vagdevi Foods)
- Incorporated: 15 September 2017
- Mill and works: Sy. Nos. 328–333, Vijayawada Road, Yadgarpally, Miryalaguda, Nalgonda District, Telangana 508207, India
- Coordinates: 16.8769° N, 79.5974° E — https://maps.google.com/?cid=10937146777008686077
- Registered office: 1-98/1/JSIC/6F/604-B, 6th Floor, Jain Sadguru Capital Park, Madhapur, Hyderabad, Telangana 500082
- Sales (call or WhatsApp): +91 90004 16808, Monday–Saturday 09:00–18:00 IST
- Email: info@vagdevifoods.com
- Farmer paddy payments: 95504 16809
- Products: JSR (Lachkari Kolam), HMT (Sona Masoori / Ponni type) and RNR (Telangana Sona) rice, steam or double boiled; rice bran, broken rice, husk
- Pack sizes: 10 kg, 26 kg, 30 kg (50 kg for bulk on request); private label available
- Certifications: ISO 22000:2018, FSSAI State Licence 13618008000475, APEDA RCMC 221976, IEC AAGCV1018C
- States supplied: Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Telangana and Odisha
- Surya rice price: ₹3,000 per 26 kg bag, ₹3,460 per 30 kg bag (about ₹115 per kg)

## Pages

- [Home](https://vagdevifoods.com/): ISO 22000:2018 rice mill in Miryalaguda, Telangana. JSR, HMT and RNR rice, steam or double boiled, for bulk, private label and export. Quotes on WhatsApp.
- [About](https://vagdevifoods.com/about): Rice millers since 2017, run by promoters with 30+ years in the paddy trade. Paddy bought direct from Nalgonda farmers and milled on one certified site.
- [The Mill](https://vagdevifoods.com/mill): Inside our rice mill at Yadgarpally: weighbridge, gate sampling, lab, drying, SATAKE milling, colour sorting and dispatch, photographed during a real shift.
- [Products](https://vagdevifoods.com/products): JSR Lachkari Kolam, HMT Sona Masoori and RNR Telangana Sona rice, steam or double boiled, in 10, 26 and 30 kg packs. Plus rice bran, broken rice and husk.
- [Exports](https://vagdevifoods.com/business): APEDA-registered rice exporter (RCMC 221976). Sona Masoori and steam rice export specifications, private label bags and a signed lab report with every lot.
- [Contact](https://vagdevifoods.com/contact): WhatsApp or call +91 90004 16808, Mon–Sat 9 am–6 pm IST. Rice mill on Vijayawada Road, Yadgarpally, Miryalaguda, Telangana 508207. Buyer visits welcome.
- [Surya Rice](https://vagdevifoods.com/surya): Surya rice: pink JSR Lachkari Kolam and black HMT boiled. ₹3,000 per 26 kg bag, ₹3,460 per 30 kg. Milled in Miryalaguda, Telangana.
